A total of 133 (64%) respondents reported intent to receive the H1N1 vaccine
Intent to receive H1N1 vaccine was associated with intent to receive the 2009--10 seasonal influenza vaccine (prevalence ratio [PR] = 2.6)
The survey consisted of 26 questions and required about 15 minutes to administer.

methods_quotes.q: A two-stage sampling method consisting of 30 random census tracts with seven randomly distributed households within each tract was used
Sample sizes for other race/ethnicities were too small to provide reliable estimates.
